identity.headline: Senior Enterprise Integration Specialist | Azure | IBM MQ | APIs | Linux | Automation

professional_summary: Senior Enterprise Integration Specialist with over 13 years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise-grade integration, cloud infrastructure, application development, and digital transformation solutions. Specialized in Azure Integration Services, IBM MQ, API development, middleware architecture, Linux systems, enterprise automation, and AMOS aviation systems. Proven track record of designing secure, scalable, high-availability integration platforms that connect mission-critical enterprise applications, automate complex business processes, and significantly improve operational efficiency across aviation and aerospace engineering sectors.
